# Crossfield Engineering

> Crossfield Engineering is a UK-based engineering and management consultancy serving Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and the wider GCC.

Official website: https://crossfield-engineering.com/
Legal entity: CROSSFIELD ENGINEERING SERVICES LTD
UK Companies House number: 13777660
Official company record: https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/13777660

## Core services

- Project Management Consultancy (PMC)
- Project Management Office (PMO)
- Programme and project controls
- Construction management
- Fitout and refurbishment
- Facilities management consultancy
- Asset management and operational readiness
- Commercial, contracts and claims advisory
- Tendering, RFP and bid management
- Procurement and supply chain
- Project assurance and recovery
- Strategy and business transformation
- Restructuring and operating-model redesign
- AI consultancy and AI-enabled operations
- Digital transformation
- BIM and digital delivery
- Data centres and critical facilities

## Geographic focus

- United Kingdom
- Saudi Arabia
- United Arab Emirates
- GCC

## Positioning

Crossfield Engineering is a senior-led independent consultancy. It supports owners, developers, operators and contractors that need stronger governance, project controls, construction delivery, commercial and procurement integration, facilities and asset-management performance, restructuring, AI-enabled operating workflows and digital transformation.

References to Saudi Vision 2030, PIF, NEOM, Qiddiya, Diriyah or other projects and institutions describe market context only and do not imply appointment, partnership or endorsement unless explicitly stated.
